tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.
keywords_missing: specific proprietary internal frameworks mentioned in the posting

cover_en.subject: Application: Associate Software Developer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Associate Software Developer position at Sanmaremployeeopenings. With over 5 years of professional backend experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services (headless APIs) for storefront and third-party consumers, and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Database & Query Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; supported production troubleshooting and maintenance.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Deployment
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.gap: While the role may involve specific internal tools or supplementary technologies not yet in my direct background, my solid foundation in Java and enterprise platforms enables me to quickly adapt and learn new systems.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, holding a valid residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, and I am available to start from 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further in an interview.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend development expertise to Sanmaremployeeopenings. Working on robust Java and SAP Commerce platforms has equipped me to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions within collaborative agile teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java backend expertise to build scalable solutions and drive high-performance e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Commerce Cloud and Java Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My background covers REST APIs, Spring, and database performance tuning. I have a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Associate Software Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Associate Software Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), I am confident in my ability to add value to your team. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
